intro: Five modules follow the AI-103 skill areas: plan and manage, generative AI and agents, computer vision, text analysis and information extraction.

modules.title: Plan and manage an Azure AI solution
modules.summary: Foundry resources and projects, model selection, deployments, security, monitoring and responsible AI.

guide.html: A Microsoft Foundry resource hosts projects, which group deployments, agents, data connections and evaluations. Choose a model from the model catalog by task, quality, latency, cost and region availability, then create a deployment (with a deployment type and capacity such as tokens per minute). Applications call the deployment by name.

Prefer Microsoft Entra ID and managed identities over API keys, grant least-privilege roles, store any secrets in Key Vault, and use private endpoints to keep traffic off the public internet. Apply content filters and Azure AI Content Safety. Monitor usage, latency and cost with Azure Monitor and tracing.

Apply fairness, reliability and safety, privacy and security, inclusiveness, transparency and accountability. Evaluate models for groundedness, relevance, safety and harmful output before and after release, and keep a human in the loop for high-impact decisions.

tips: Quota is per deployment and region.
Evaluate before shipping and keep monitoring.

modules.title: Implement generative AI and agentic solutions
modules.summary: Prompting, RAG, tools, agents, orchestration and evaluation.

guide.html: The system message sets role, rules and format. Few-shot examples guide output. Temperature controls randomness; lower is more deterministic. Send conversation history to keep context, and watch the context window and token costs. Structured outputs constrain a reply to a JSON schema.

RAG grounds answers in your data. Documents are chunked, converted to embeddings and stored in a vector index such as Azure AI Search. At question time the app retrieves relevant chunks (often hybrid search combining keyword and vector, with a semantic ranker) and adds them to the prompt. RAG reduces hallucinations without retraining; fine-tuning changes model behavior or style.

An agent combines a model, instructions and tools (file search, code interpreter, function calling, web search, MCP servers) and can plan multi-step work. A conversation is a thread and each execution is a run. Multi-agent patterns split work among specialist agents. Guard agents with limited tool permissions, approvals for risky actions and tracing for review.

tips: RAG for fresh or private knowledge; fine-tuning for style or behavior.
Give agents the fewest tools they need.
terms: Retrieval-augmented generation: ground answers in retrieved data.
Lets a model request your code to be run.

modules.title: Implement computer vision solutions
modules.summary: Image analysis, OCR, multimodal models and video.

guide.html: Azure AI Vision analyzes images: captions, tags, object detection, people detection and OCR (reading text). Multimodal models accept images in a prompt for questions and descriptions. Custom image models classify (one label per image) or detect objects (labels with bounding boxes) for your own categories. Video can be sampled into frames or analyzed for indexing and search.

Use prebuilt image analysis when general tags and captions are enough. Use a multimodal chat model for flexible questions about an image. Train a custom model when your categories are specific. Always consider content safety for user-supplied images and avoid unsupported identification of people.

tips: Classification: what is it? Detection: what and where?
Use OCR to read text from images.
Multimodal models answer free-form questions about images.

modules.title: Implement text analysis solutions
modules.summary: Language understanding, sentiment, entities, summarization, translation and speech.

guide.html: Azure AI Language offers sentiment analysis and opinion mining, key phrase extraction, named entity recognition, PII detection and redaction, language detection, summarization and question answering. Conversational language understanding extracts intents and entities from utterances. Azure AI Translator translates text and documents. Azure AI Speech covers speech-to-text, text-to-speech and speech translation.

Large language models can summarize, classify and extract structured fields with a good prompt and structured output. Prefer a dedicated service for deterministic tasks like PII redaction, and an LLM for flexible reasoning. Always evaluate accuracy on your own examples.

tips: Intent = what the user wants; entity = the detail.
Use PII detection before storing text.

modules.title: Implement information extraction solutions
modules.summary: Document intelligence, content understanding, knowledge mining and search enrichment.

guide.html: Azure AI Document Intelligence extracts text, tables, key-value pairs and fields from forms using prebuilt models (invoices, receipts, IDs) or custom models. Azure AI Content Understanding extracts structured output from documents, images, audio and video using analyzers you define. Output feeds downstream apps or a search index.

guide.h: Knowledge mining with Azure AI Search
guide.html: An indexer pulls data from a source into an index; a skillset applies AI enrichment (OCR, entity recognition, key phrases, image analysis, custom skills) during indexing. Enriched content can be projected into a knowledge store. Index fields can be searchable, filterable, sortable or facetable. Combine keyword, vector and semantic ranking for best relevance.

tips: Prebuilt models for common documents; custom for your own forms.
terms: Extracts text, tables and fields from documents.
Pulls data from a source into a search index.
